expected_differences: The D initial and demo-creator identity correctly replace Maya’s fixture portrait and name; production does not need the Lab’s Demo account label.
Message and notification badges expose production counts of 2 and 3.
Activity appropriately replaces discovery filters with To do 4, In review 1, History 1 and Saved.
The four records show distinct operational states: Request for you, Changes requested, Accepted and Awaiting installation.
Record-specific businesses, titles, supplied artwork and reference thumbnails correctly replace the Lab assets. Landscape sources remain contained rather than forced into portrait crops.
The actual amounts—$30.00, $75.00, $25.00 and $300.00—retain their displayed approval, approved-version and monthly bases rather than inheriting fixture payment terms.
keep: Mineral canvas, dark identity and navigation text, muted metadata, thin dividers and shadow-free rows.
The 12px downward handoff from each thumbnail reservation to its action-and-facts column; this translates the signature without importing Home’s opportunity-card silhouettes.
Action-first hierarchy with consistent 18/24px, weight-500 task headings, followed by literal status, record identity and bold money with its basis.
View booking above Awaiting installation: a waiting record now presents an available action without implying installation is complete.
Distinct waiting and confirmed status colors accompanied by readable words, not color-only meaning.
The unchanged utility controls and Home, Activity, Earnings, Profile navigation order, with restrained cobalt selection edges.
review.readiness_note: Visual sign-off at 390px. The document-end navigation placement is the declared full-page capture override, not a regression. The capture establishes visible functionality, but cannot verify destination routing, mutations or failure handling.
review.why: This is a faithful Activity adaptation, not a layout that should duplicate Home. The 16px page gutters, mineral surface, contained media, stepped source-to-action alignment and flat separators carry the approved language. Every visible row provides a clear next action, an independent literal state and an untruncated amount with its payment basis. Longer record descriptions wrap cleanly, and the final booking amount remains clear of navigation. All four To do records are exposed, alongside the other activity destinations and shell controls. Nothing visible substitutes decorative progress, guaranteed earnings or invented media for the real workflow.
review.verdict: Yes—Frame Shift is faithfully translated to Activity at 390px, with no visible implementation drift or loss of the real queue, states, payment semantics and navigation.
